source.notes: Six-panel pencil contact sheet; review before cropping.

final_elements.name: trowel blade
final_elements.description: Draw a pointed scoop as two gently curved sides meeting at a rounded tip.

final_elements.name: blade neck
final_elements.description: From the broad top of the blade, draw a narrow neck that meets both blade shoulders.

final_elements.name: wooden handle
final_elements.description: From the narrow neck, add a small collar and a rounded wooden grip angled up-right; close its top.

final_elements.name: soil mound
final_elements.description: Under the blade tip, sketch a low irregular mound with a clear contact point.

final_elements.name: loose soil crumbs
final_elements.description: Add three small soil crumbs beside the mound and two short grain marks inside the handle.
